text: 波兰预计到本十年末经济增速将放缓至2%，因政府将不得不加大力度应对财政赤字。波兰财政部周五晚间公布的明年预算计划立法草案显示，随着投资支出和私人消费放缓，预计未来几年经济增速将从2026年的3.6%逐步下降。根据该计划，财政部预计财政赤字仍将维持在占经济产出7%以上的高位，同时预计通胀率到2030年将放缓至2.5%。财政部表示，主要风险来自中东局势以及邻国乌克兰的事态发展。在2029年至2030年期间，为遵守审慎规则而计划采取的措施将“放缓经济增长步伐”，预计2029年GDP增长2.1%，2030年增长2.0%。波兰总理图斯克周五表示，随着俄罗斯加剧与欧
text_en: Poland expects economic growth to slow to 2% by the end of the decade as the government will have to intensify efforts to tackle the fiscal deficit. According to the draft budget legislation for next year published by the Polish Finance Ministry on Friday evening, economic growth is expected to gradually decline from 3.6% in 2026 as investment spending and private consumption slow. Under the plan, the Finance Ministry expects the fiscal deficit to remain high at over 7% of economic output, while inflation is expected to slow to 2.5% by 2030. The ministry said main risks come from the situation in the Middle East and developments in neighboring Ukraine. Measures planned for 2029-2030 to comply with prudential rules will "slow the pace of economic growth," with GDP growth expected at 2.1% in 2029 and 2.0% in 2030.
